resources.string:
This app can read the text of notifications from apps such as WhatsApp, Telegram, Gmail and Messenger, to warn you when a message looks like a scam.

• What is read: the sender and text of notifications from supported apps.
• Why: only to detect fraud and show you an alert.
• Where: it is analyzed on your device. We do not send, sell or share your notification content with anyone.
• A record of each alert (risk level, sender name and a short excerpt of the flagged message) is kept on your phone only.

You can turn this access off at any time in your phone's settings.
